fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM95,390. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0056486/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Certificate in Matriculation or Foundation with a minimum CGPA of 2.0 and a pass in Mathematics at SPM level or equivalent; OR STPM with TWO full passes with a minimum CGPA of 2.0 and a pass in Mathematics at SPM level or equivalent; OR STAM with a minimum grade of Jayyid and a pass in Mathematics at SPM level or equivalent; OR Diploma (MQF Level 4) in MIF or related fields with a minimum CGPA of 2.5 or equivalent (CGPAs below 2.5 but above 2.0 may be admitted subject to internal assessment); OR Any other Diploma (MQF Level 4) with a minimum CGPA of 2.5; OR Other relevant equivalent qualifications recognised by the Malaysian Government. Notes: Pass in Mathematics at SPM may be waived if the qualification contains Mathematics with equivalent or higher achievement. Arabic enhancement course required unless a pass in Arabic at STPM/STAM/Matriculation/Foundation/Diploma or equivalent is presented. Passing Arabic enhancement is prerequisite for core courses requiring it. Arabic enhancement course credits are additional and may be counted towards graduation.
